title: Principal Private Secretary (PPS)
location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (All India transfer liability)
salary_range: Level 11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
age_limit: Not exceeding 56 years on the closing date of application
summary: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) invites applications for one vacant post of Principal Private Secretary on a deputation basis for an initial period of three years. Eligible candidates working in Central/State Governments, Public Sector Undertakings, or autonomous bodies may apply through proper channel within 45 days of advertisement publication.
eligibility_bullets: Open to officers under Central/State Governments, Statutory/Autonomous bodies, or Public Sector Undertakings.
Must be holding analogous posts on regular basis OR holding post in Level 7 or Level 8 in the Pay Matrix with 7 years of regular service.
Age must not exceed 56 years on the closing date of application.
Must submit applications Through Proper Channel along with last 5 years' APARs and vigilance clearance.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the prescribed proforma from the official website www.iwai.gov.in.
Fill in the application form completely in Hindi or English, affixing a self-attested passport-size photograph.
Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and the last 5 years' APARs through proper channel.

Send the application in a closed envelope superscribed with the post name and notice number via Registered Post or Speed Post to the Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), Inland Waterways Authority of India, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301 (U.P.).
